description: This file defines the interface and class for the calculator engine, including class CCalcEngine, related enums, and function declarations. It includes member variables, methods, and static functions for managing calculator operations, display, and internal state.

classes.name: CCalcEngine
classes.description: Main class implementing the calculator engine, managing calculations, display, input, and internal state.

classes.name: CalculationManager::IResourceProvider
classes.description: Interface for resource provisioning, used by CCalcEngine.

classes.name: CalculatorEngineTests::CalcEngineTests
classes.description: Test class for CCalcEngine, used in unit testing.

methods.name: CCalcEngine
methods.description: Constructor initializing the calculator engine with configuration flags and resource pointers.

methods.name: ProcessCommand
methods.description: Processes a calculator command identified by OpCode.

methods.name: DisplayError
methods.description: Displays an error message based on error code.

methods.name: PersistedMemObject
methods.description: Returns the current memory object as a Rational pointer.

methods.name: PersistedMemObject (setter)
methods.description: Sets the memory object to a given Rational value.

methods.name: FInErrorState
methods.description: Checks if the calculator is in an error state.

methods.name: IsInputEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the current input is empty or zero.

methods.name: FInRecordingState
methods.description: Checks if the calculator is in recording mode.

methods.name: SettingsChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in calculator settings.

methods.name: IsCurrentTooBigForTrig
methods.description: Determines if the current value exceeds trig function limits.

methods.name: GetCurrentRadix
methods.description: Returns the current radix/base.

methods.name: GetCurrentResultForRadix
methods.description: Returns the current calculation result formatted for a specific radix.

methods.name: ChangePrecision
methods.description: Changes the display precision and updates constants accordingly.

methods.name: GroupDigitsPerRadix
methods.description: Groups digits of a number string according to radix-specific grouping.

methods.name: GetStringForDisplay
methods.description: Converts a Rational number to a display string in a given radix.

methods.name: UpdateMaxIntDigits
methods.description: Updates the maximum integer digits allowed.

methods.name: DecimalSeparator
methods.description: Returns the decimal separator character.

methods.name: GetHistoryCollectorCommandsSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current history commands.

methods.name: InitialOneTimeOnlySetup
methods.description: Performs one-time setup for the calculator engine.

methods.name: GetString
methods.description: Retrieves string representations for command IDs or string IDs.

methods.name: OpCodeToString
methods.description: Converts an OpCode to its string representation.

methods.name: OpCodeToUnaryString
methods.description: Converts an OpCode to its unary string form, considering inversion and angle type.

methods.name: OpCodeToBinaryString
methods.description: Converts an OpCode to its binary string form, considering integer mode.
